# Machine Gun Rabbit

> Machine Gun Rabbit is a five-piece party and cover band from Calgary, Alberta, playing 50+ sing-along songs a night, from ABBA to AC/DC.

Band: Libby (vocals), Mike (vocals, rhythm guitar), Phil (lead guitar), Jeff (bass), Tyler (drums).
Available for bars, weddings, private parties and festivals in Calgary and area.
To book: call or text Phil at (403) 669-8116.
